ohtani.title: Emmet Sheehan's superb outing fuels Dodgers' 6-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Teoscar Hernández belts a three-run homer and Emmet Sheehan strikes out 10 to lead the Dodgers over the Reds, 6-3

imanaga.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong lifts two homers in Cubs' win
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong lifts two home runs and an RBI triple to propel the Cubs to an 8-4 win over the Braves

suzuki.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong lifts two homers in Cubs' win
suzuki.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong lifts two home runs and an RBI triple to propel the Cubs to an 8-4 win over the Braves

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Blue Jays manufacture runs to back Scherzer in win
okamoto.blurb: Myles Straw's RBI single highlights the Blue Jays offense to back Max Scherzer's solid outing in a 5-1 win over the Tigers

murakami.title: Munetaka Murakami homers in White Sox 3-1 win
murakami.blurb: Munetaka Murakami homers and Randal Grichuk makes a crucial throw to propel the White Sox to a 3-1 win over the Tigers

matsui.title: Xander Bogaerts leads offense with 3 RBIs in 9-2 win
matsui.blurb: Xander Bogaerts leads the Padres' red-hot offense with 3 RBIs and Michael King strikes out six in the Padres' 9-3 win over the Rockies
